returns.timestamp: Unix timestamp of last price update

returns.decimals: Number of decimals (always 18)  Reverts if: - Asset not supported - Feed inactive - Price is invalid (≤ 0) - Price is stale (older than heartbeat + 5 min buffer)

params.heartbeat: Expected update frequency in seconds  Requirements: - asset and feed must not be zero addresses - heartbeat must be > 0 - feed must be callable and return valid data

returns.supported: True if feed is registered and active
